name: 反击战
detailed_description:
Authentic Historical Battlefield Restoration​

Our game development team has delved deep into historical materials of the Counterattack against Vietnam, meticulously replicating every detail from terrain features to climatic conditions. Whether it’s the dense jungles or rugged mountainous regions, we strive to immerse players in the authentic southern border battlefield. The game features iconic battle scenarios, including the Shuo Jiang Campaign, the Lang Son Campaign, and the Cao Bang Campaign, enabling you to understand history through combat and remember the heroic feats of those who fought.​

Diverse Gameplay Modes​

Single - Player Campaign: Follow a carefully crafted storyline and experience the war from the perspective of an ordinary soldier. Progress from the core of the conflict, completing challenging missions like scouting enemy positions, launching surprise attacks on enemy camps, and escorting vital supplies. Grow through battles and witness the full scope of the war.​

Multiplayer Battles: Team up with other players for intense confrontations. Coordinate closely with your comrades, devise strategies, and compete for key strongholds or execute enemy annihilation missions. In multiplayer battles, both teamwork and individual skills are crucial, allowing you to enhance your combat proficiency through competition with other players.​

Co - op Mode: A series of highly challenging levels designed for team collaboration await. These levels test your limitless operation skills and adaptability. Facing powerful enemy firepower and complex battlefield environments, you must perform at your best to overcome obstacles and reap rich rewards.​

Diverse Weaponry System​

The game faithfully restores a vast array of weapons used by our military during the Counterattack against Vietnam, such as the Type 63 automatic rifle, the Type 56 submachine gun, and the Type 65 82 - millimeter recoilless rifle. Each weapon boasts unique performance characteristics and handling, enabling you to choose the most suitable one based on different combat scenarios and mission requirements. Additionally, by completing tasks and leveling up, you can unlock weapon modification accessories to enhance their performance and gain an edge on the battlefield.​

Realistic Combat Experience​

Utilizing advanced physics engines, the game simulates realistic bullet trajectories, explosive effects, and damage mechanisms. Every shot and explosion conveys a powerful impact. The character's injury status is reflected in real - time, with different injured body parts affecting movement in various ways, enhancing the game's realism and challenge. Moreover, the game incorporates a weather system and day - night cycle, where different environmental conditions influence combat, requiring you to adjust your tactics flexibly according to the situation.​

Join Counterattack now! Showcase your courage and wisdom on the virtual battlefield, fight to defend the integrity of the motherland's territory, and relive that unforgettable and passionate era!​

short_description: Enter Counterattack, and instantly travel back to the smoke-filled southern border battlefield of 1979. Every detail here echoes the historical authenticity, immersing you in the thick of battle.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 @3.1 GHz, Intel Core i5 4460 @ 3.2 GHz, or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon R9 280X or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 (4 GB VRAM with Shader Model 5.0 or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 80 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600 @3.2 GHz, Intel Core i7 6700K @4.0 GHz, or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 480 or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB VRAM with Shader Model 5.0 or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
